  <rdfs:label>Achievement</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Answers CQ05; specialized under friendAchievementRelation</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ05: What are the achievements of my friends?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Friend"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Achievement"/>
  <rdfs:subPropertyOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#friendAchievementRelation"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Friend -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Achievement -->
  <!-- Axiom: SubPropertyOf friendAchievementRelation -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#received">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates a friend to an achievement they have received.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Received</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Answers CQ07; specialized under friendAchievementRelation</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ07: What are the achievements your friend has received?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Friend"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Achievement"/>
  <rdfs:subPropertyOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#friendAchievementRelation"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Friend -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Achievement -->
  <!-- Axiom: SubPropertyOf friendAchievementRelation -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#hasAchievement">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates an achievement owner to an achievement they possess.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Has Achievement</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Answers CQ08, CQ27, CQ35 using shared domain</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ08: What achievements does a game have?
    (competency_question) CQ27: What achievements of a certain type does the player have?
    (competency_question) CQ35: In how many games does the player have all the achievements?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#AchievementOwner"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Achievement"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain AchievementOwner -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Achievement -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#type">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates an achievement to its classification type.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Type</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Answers CQ10, CQ11, CQ27 for achievement categorization</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ10: What are the types of achievements in this game?
    (competency_question) CQ11: What are the types of achievements a game can have?
    (competency_question) CQ27: What achievements of a certain type does the player have?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Achievement"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#AchievementType"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Achievement -->
  <!-- Axiom: range AchievementType -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#genre">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates a game to its thematic genre.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Genre</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Answers CQ12 and CQ17 for game classification</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ12: What is the genre of the game?
    (competency_question) CQ17: List all games of a certain Genre?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Game"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Genre"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Game -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Genre -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#hasItem">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates an item owner to an item they possess.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Has Item</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Answers CQ13 and CQ26 using shared domain</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ13: What items exist in a game?
    (competency_question) CQ26: What items does the player have?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#ItemOwner"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Item"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain ItemOwner -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Item -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#hasAbility">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates an item to the abilities it provides.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Has Ability</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Answers CQ19 for item capabilities</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ19: What abilities does an item have?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Item"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Ability"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Item -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Ability -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#playsIn">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates a player to a game they are currently playing.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Plays In</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Answers CQ22, CQ52, CQ64; specialized under gameInteraction</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ22: Who has the best kill count in the game?
    (competency_question) CQ52: What equipment does a player have in a game?
    (competency_question) CQ64: How long does a player spend in the game before making first IAP?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Player"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Game"/>
  <rdfs:subPropertyOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#gameInteraction"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Player -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Game -->
  <!-- Axiom: SubPropertyOf gameInteraction -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#obtained">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates a player to an achievement they have unlocked.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Obtained</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Answers CQ24 for player achievements</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ24: What achievements has a player obtained?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Player"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Achievement"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Player -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Achievement -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#played">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates a player to a game they have played.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Played</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Answers CQ25, CQ29, CQ35; specialized under gameInteraction</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ25: What games has the player played?
    (competency_question) CQ29: What is the last game a player has played?
    (competency_question) CQ35: In how many games does the player have all the achievements?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Player"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Game"/>
  <rdfs:subPropertyOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#gameInteraction"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Player -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Game -->
  <!-- Axiom: SubPropertyOf gameInteraction -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#hasEquipment">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates a player to equipment they possess.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Has Equipment</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Answers CQ52 for player gear</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ52: What equipment does a player have in a game?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Player"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Equipment"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Player -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Equipment -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#uses">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates a player to an item they utilize.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Uses</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Answers CQ55 for item usage</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ55: What are the games where a player can use this item?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Player"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Item"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Player -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Item -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#hasMade">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates a player to an in-app purchase they completed.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Has Made</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Answers CQ56, CQ57, CQ63, CQ64, CQ65, CQ66 for spending behavior</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ56: How many players have made in app purchases?
    (competency_question) CQ57: How many players who have already spent money, spend money again?
    (competency_question) CQ63: Where do the most paying customers live?
    (competency_question) CQ64: How long does a player spend in the game before making first IAP?
    (competency_question) CQ65: Where do the players live who have not made any IAP?
    (competency_question) CQ66: Where do the players who have done the most IAP live?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Player"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#InAppPurchase"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Player -->
  <!-- Axiom: range InAppPurchase -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#livesIn">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates a player to their geographic location.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Lives In</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Answers CQ63, CQ65, CQ66 for demographic filtering</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ63: Where do the most paying customers live?
    (competency_question) CQ65: Where do the players live who have not made any IAP?
    (competency_question) CQ66: Where do the players who have done the most IAP live?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Player"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Location"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Player -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Location -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#hasPlayingArea">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates a game to its distinct playing zones.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Has Playing Area</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Answers New CQ1 for game map structure</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) New CQ1: What playing areas does a game have?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Game"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#PlayingArea"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Game -->
  <!-- Axiom: range PlayingArea -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#gameInteraction">
  <rdfs:comment>General relation connecting a player to a game.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Game Interaction</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] coined: Unifies played and playsIn which share domain Player and range Game</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ25: What games has the player played?
    (competency_question) CQ29: What is the last game a player has played?
    (competency_question) CQ35: In how many games does the player have all the achievements?
    (competency_question) CQ22: Who has the best kill count in the game?
    (competency_question) CQ52: What equipment does a player have in a game?
    (competency_question) CQ64: How long does a player spend in the game before making first IAP?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Player"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Game"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Player -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Game -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#friendAchievementRelation">
  <rdfs:comment>General relation connecting a friend to an achievement.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Friend Achievement Relation</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] coined: Unifies achievement and received which share domain Friend and range Achievement</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ05: What are the achievements of my friends?
    (competency_question) CQ07: What are the achievements your friend has received?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Friend"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Achievement"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Friend -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Achievement -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

  <!-- owl:DatatypeProperty declarations -->

<owl:DatatypeProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#username">
  <rdfs:comment>The unique identifier string for a player.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Username</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Answers CQ01 for player identification</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ01: What is the username of the player?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Player"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string"/>
  <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#FunctionalProperty"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Player -->
  <!-- Axiom: range string -->
</owl:DatatypeProperty>

<owl:DatatypeProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#totalPlayHours">
  <rdfs:comment>The cumulative time spent playing a game.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Total Play Hours</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Answers CQ09 for gameplay duration metrics</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ09: How many hours has this game been played in total?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Game"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#float"/>
  <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#FunctionalProperty"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Game -->
  <!-- Axiom: range float -->
</owl:DatatypeProperty>

<owl:DatatypeProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#releaseDate">
  <rdfs:comment>The calendar date when a game was published.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Release Date</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Answers CQ15 for game publication timing</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ15: What is the release date of the game?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Game"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime"/>
  <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#FunctionalProperty"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Game -->
  <!-- Axiom: range dateTime -->
</owl:DatatypeProperty>

<owl:DatatypeProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#killCount">
  <rdfs:comment>The number of eliminations recorded for a player.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Kill Count</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Answers CQ22 for player performance metrics</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ22: Who has the best kill count in the game?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Player"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer"/>
  <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#FunctionalProperty"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Player -->
  <!-- Axiom: range integer -->
</owl:DatatypeProperty>

<owl:DatatypeProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#playedAt">
  <rdfs:comment>The timestamp when a player last played a game.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Played At</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Answers CQ29 for recency tracking</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ29: What is the last game a player has played?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Player"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime"/>
  <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#FunctionalProperty"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Player -->
  <!-- Axiom: range dateTime -->
</owl:DatatypeProperty>

<owl:DatatypeProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#playDuration">
  <rdfs:comment>The time a player spends in a game before specific events.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Play Duration</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Answers CQ64 for engagement timing analysis</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ64: How long does a player spend in the game before making first IAP?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Player"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#float"/>
  <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#FunctionalProperty"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Player -->
  <!-- Axiom: range float -->
</owl:DatatypeProperty>

<owl:DatatypeProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#doneAt">
  <rdfs:comment>The timestamp when an in-app purchase was completed.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Done At</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Answers CQ62 and CQ64 for transaction timing</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ62: What time are most of the in app purchases done?
    (competency_question) CQ64: How long does a player spend in the game before making first IAP?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#InAppPurchase"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime"/>
  <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#FunctionalProperty"/>

  <!-- Axiom: range dateTime -->

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<rdf:RDF xml:base="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#"
         xmlns:owl="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#"
         xmlns:rdf="http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#"
         xmlns:rdfs="http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#"
         xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#"
         xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"
         xmlns:vaem="http://www.linkedmodel.org/schema/vaem#">

  <owl:Ontology rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#"/>

  <!-- owl:Class declarations -->

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Player">
  <rdfs:comment>A user of the gaming platform who plays games, owns items, and makes purchases.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Player</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Core entity supplied across multiple CQs</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ01: What is the username of the player?
    (competency_question) CQ02: Who are the friends of the player?
    (competency_question) CQ22: Who has the best kill count in the game?
    (competency_question) CQ24: What achievements has a player obtained?
    (competency_question) CQ25: What games has the player played?
    (competency_question) CQ26: What items does the player have?
    (competency_question) CQ27: What achievements of a certain type does the player have?
    (competency_question) CQ29: What is the last game a player has played?
    (competency_question) CQ35: In how many games does the player have all the achievements?
    (competency_question) CQ52: What equipment does a player have in a game?
    (competency_question) CQ55: What are the games where a player can use this item?
    (competency_question) CQ56: How many players have made in app purchases?
    (competency_question) CQ63: Where do the most paying customers live?
    (competency_question) CQ64: How long does a player spend in the game before making first IAP?
    (competency_question) CQ65: Where do the players live who have not made any IAP?
    (competency_question) CQ66: Where do the players who have done the most IAP live?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#AchievementOwner"/>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#ItemOwner"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf AchievementOwner -->
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf ItemOwner -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Friend">
  <rdfs:comment>A player designated as a friend of another player.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Friend</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Range of the friend relation and domain for friend-specific queries</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ02: Who are the friends of the player?
    (competency_question) CQ03: Who are the friends that play other games as well with this player?
    (competency_question) CQ05: What are the achievements of my friends?
    (competency_question) CQ07: What are the achievements your friend has received?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Game">
  <rdfs:comment>A digital game that can be played, contains items, and has achievements.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Game</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Central entity for gameplay, content, and statistics queries</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ03: Who are the friends that play other games as well with this player?
    (competency_question) CQ08: What achievements does a game have?
    (competency_question) CQ09: How many hours has this game been played in total?
    (competency_question) CQ12: What is the genre of the game?
    (competency_question) CQ13: What items exist in a game?
    (competency_question) CQ15: What is the release date of the game?
    (competency_question) CQ17: List all games of a certain Genre?
    (competency_question) CQ22: Who has the best kill count in the game?
    (competency_question) CQ25: What games has the player played?
    (competency_question) CQ29: What is the last game a player has played?
    (competency_question) CQ35: In how many games does the player have all the achievements?
    (competency_question) CQ52: What equipment does a player have in a game?
    (competency_question) CQ64: How long does a player spend in the game before making first IAP?
    (competency_question) New CQ1: What playing areas does a game have?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#AchievementOwner"/>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#ItemOwner"/>
  <owl:disjointWith rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/vgo#Player"/>
  <!-- Axiom: Disjoint with Player -->
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf AchievementOwner -->
